title: Last-Letter Chain · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Last-Letter Chain · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a starting word. The lead names two new words in sequence, each beginning with the last letter of the preceding word. Both links follow the last-letter rule. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Last-Letter Chain, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both links follow the last-letter rule.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: Both links follow the last-letter rule.
